bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; owner=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -A -t -c "SELECT owner_user_id FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='room' AND revision=141 AND step='preview'"); test -n "$owner" || exit 74; docker exec -e TARGET_OWNER="$owner" deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs -e "const fs=require(\"node:fs\"),https=require(\"node:https\");const token=fs.readFileSync(\"/run/secrets/bot_token\",\"utf8\").trim();const user=Number(process.env.TARGET_OWNER);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(user)||user<=0)process.exit(72);const url=new URL(\"https://api.telegram.org/bot\"+token+\"/getChat\");url.searchParams.set(\"chat_id\",String(user));const req=https.get(url,{family:4,timeout:12000},r=>{let s=\"\";r.on(\"data\",c=>s+=c);r.on(\"end\",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(s);const u=j.result?.username;const pass=j.ok&&typeof u===\"string\"&&/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{4,31}$/.test(u);console.log(\"OWNER_USERNAME=\"+(pass?\"VERIFIED\":\"NOT_VERIFIED\"));process.exit(pass?0:71)}catch(e){console.log(\"USERNAME_READ=ERROR\");process.exit(72)}})});req.on(\"error\",()=>process.exit(73));req.on(\"timeout\",()=>req.destroy())"
